## 0.1.6-alpha.2

### Changes

- feat(cli): use runtime resolution for plain Node launches
- feat(client): open subagent chats in sidebar
- feat(web): keep plan artifacts and automatically open sidebar previews
- feat(docs): 增加 Python SDK 平台命令标签

- feat(web): host plugin configuration on the Plugins page
- feat(client): lead known-site links with the site's own mark
- 轮次 Review tab：逐文件对比改动
- 代码 diff 卡片
- feat(creator): use Plugin Manager for persistent plugins

- feat(web): add opt-in Workspace tree grouping

- feat(desktop): enable standalone Office skills

- feat(llm): drop the V4 Flash and V4 Flash Vision Exp default models

- feat(web): manage global plugins from the sidebar
- feat: support weighted approval delegation
- feat(desktop): use native dialogs for fatal recovery
- Optimize Web startup dependency loading
